item.title: South Carolina Is 2026’s 9th Worst State to Raise a Family – WalletHub Study
item.description: Personal finance website WalletHub today released its report on 2026's Best & Worst States to Raise a Family and South Carolina was listed as the 9th worst in the country. The Palmetto State had the exact same ranking last year.

item.title: From One Pound to the Runway: Heart Disease Survivor Promotes Memoir for American Heart Month
item.description: This February, as the nation observes American Heart Month, Charleston based author and fashion model Cheri Glover is sharing a story of survival that began long before she ever stepped onto a runway.

item.title: Former MLS champion forward Miguel Berry joins Battery
item.description: The Charleston Battery are delighted to announce the signing of Spanish forward Miguel Berry to the 2026 roster on Monday, pending league and federation approval.

item.title: Charleston Main Library Renovations to Begin in 2026
item.description: Charleston County Public Library (CCPL) will begin renovations of its Main Library, located at 68 Calhoun Street in Downtown Charleston, in 2026, marking the final phase of the referendum-funded project approved by voters in 2014.

item.title: 6 Tips For A Stylish And Relaxed Poolside Setup
item.description: A great pool day starts before your first dip. It starts with a setup that looks good, feels calm, and works hard in the heat. Use these six tips to shape a space that invites you to stay a little longer.

item.description: The Charleston County Board of Voter Registration and Elections is reminding voters that recent changes in U.S. Postal Service (USPS) mail processing guidelines may affect when mailed voter registration materials receive an official postmark.

item.title: Keys to Change To Host Midwinter Affair
item.description: Keys To Change will host the annual Midwinter Affair on Saturday, Jan. 31, 2026, at The Kersey House in Summerville, welcoming community leaders, neighbors, and supporters for an evening of fellowship, refreshments, live entertainment, and more
